description: This file implements an in-memory rate limiting middleware for a web application using the Starlette framework. It defines the RateLimitMiddleware class that applies a per-request key limit over a specified time window, managing request buckets with timestamps to enforce rate constraints.

classes.name: RateLimitMiddleware
classes.description: A middleware class for applying rate limiting based on request keys, maintaining request timestamps in buckets and returning 429 responses when exceeding limits.

methods.name: __init__( self, app, requests: int, window_seconds: int, key_func: Callable[[dict], str], )
methods.description: Initializes the RateLimitMiddleware with application, request limit, time window, and key generation function.

methods.name: dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next)
methods.description: Handles each incoming request, updates request buckets, enforces rate limit, and adds rate limit headers to responses.

ctags.signature: ( self, app, requests: int, window_seconds: int, key_func: Callable[[dict], str], )
